Game Overview

In Fire Truck Driver, the core idea is straightforward: race against time as a fearless firefighter in Fire Truck Driver. Navigate bustling city streets with arcade-style controls, putting out fires and upgrading your trucks. Master 15 thrilling levels filled with unique challenges, strategic water management, and high-speed dashes to save the day.
